page_title: TOU 0-0 NAN | Toulouse v Nantes 18/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+5' What a huge chance for Yann Gboho (Toulouse). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
90+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Toulouse comes to nothing.

90+4' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Alban Lafont thwarts him with a great two-handed save. Toulouse force their opponents to concede a corner.
90+3' Nantes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+3' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Nathan Zeze (Nantes) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball goes out of play. Nantes are awarded a corner kick.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Here comes a substitution. Sorba Thomas is given a rest as he is replaced by Nicolas Pallois (Nantes).
90' Antoine Kombouare prepares a substitution. Matthis Abline is replaced by Bahereba Guirassy (Nantes).
89' Nantes will take a free kick. Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
86' Substitution. Frank Magri did his best and is replaced by Naatan Skytta (Toulouse).
86' Here is a change. Warren Kamanzi is going off and Carles Martinez gives the last tactical orders to Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse).
84' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle after Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Toulouse have a free kick.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Johann Lepenant (Nantes) replaces Tino Kadewere.
82' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his low effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Alban Lafont.
82' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.

81' Tino Kadewere (Nantes) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nantes.
80' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Toulouse.
79' The ball is cleared after Yann Gboho (Toulouse) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Toulouse.
75' Antoine Kombouare has decided to substitute Marcus Coco and he is replaced by Jean-Kevin Duverne (Nantes).
75' It will be a substitution. Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is ready to enter the pitch as Moses Simon walks off.
74' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) jumps into a tackle and Jeremy Stinat signals a foul.
71' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) was quite harsh and Jeremy Stinat didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
71' Marcus Coco (Nantes) is booked.
68' Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

67' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Toulouse will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
65' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the bottom left corner is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
64' Nantes have been awarded a corner kick.
64' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety. Nantes have a corner.
61' Carles Martinez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) replacing Aron Donnum.
61' Substitution. Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) has come on for Niklas Schmidt.

61' The corner is swung in and Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) leaps above the defence only to send his header a whisker wide of the right post from close in. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
61' Niklas Schmidt (Toulouse) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
60' Toulouse fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air. Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick.
60' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Aron Donnum (Toulouse) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Now Toulouse have a corner.
58' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
57' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
57' The referee blows his whistle as Yann Gboho (Toulouse) was too aggressive in his challenge.
52' Poor challenge! Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) is penalised for tripping and Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle. A free kick to Nantes.
50' The corner is swung in but Nantes can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

50' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Tino Kadewere (Nantes) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The ball goes behind for a corner. Nantes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
48' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Yellow card. Tino Kadewere (Nantes) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.

45' Matthis Abline (Nantes) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.
44' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Nantes have a free kick.
42' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for an infringement.
39' The resulting set piece from Toulouse is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
38' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Toulouse force a corner. They send men into the box.

37' Alban Lafont makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Yann Gboho (Toulouse) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the middle of the goal.
37' Toulouse can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
36' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The linesman makes the right call and Toulouse will have a corner.
35' Rough tackle by Matthis Abline (Nantes). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Toulouse have been awarded a free kick.
31' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle for a foul after Aron Donnum (Toulouse) hacks down one of his opponents. Nantes are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
29' Toulouse fail to score from a corner as Alban Lafont (Nantes) leaps to collect the ball.

29' What a great chance for Frank Magri (Toulouse). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header right under the bar, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save. It will be a corner kick for Toulouse.
28' Toulouse force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

27' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the top right corner. Alban Lafont is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. The ball is out of play and Toulouse manage to earn a corner.
24' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) for his blatant foul.

22' Sorba Thomas (Nantes) takes a nice first touch to control a cross and shoots at goal from near the penalty spot, but his effort only hits the bar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Toulouse.

18' The cross fools the defence and leaves Matthis Abline (Nantes) with an easy chance inside the box, but he mistimes his shot and sends it just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Toulouse will have a goal kick.
16' A corner kick by Nantes is thwarted by the well prepared Guillaume Restes (Toulouse).

16' Wow, what an escape. Matthis Abline (Nantes) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. Nantes have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
15' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
13' The referee blows his whistle after Marcus Coco (Nantes) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
9' Jeremy Stinat has a clear sight and sees a foul from Marcus Coco (Nantes).
8' Toulouse failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
8' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play. Toulouse are awarded a corner kick.
5' Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle and signals a foul after Rasmus Nicolaisen (Toulouse) brought his opponent down.
3' Kelvin Amian (Nantes) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Toulouse.
1' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Nantes in a dangerous position.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Nantes will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Jeremy Stinat.
